part.text:
Fixed. The root cause: the page reverse index (used by `Site.GetPage` short-name lookups) in `newPageMap` (hugolib/content_map_page.go:957) indexed pages by their source file's path. Pages created by content adapters are associated with the `_content.gotmpl` file, so they were indexed under the wrong base name (the section name, e.g. `s2`) and `GetPage "p2"` missed them.

The fix indexes adapter pages by their canonical page path (`p.m.pathInfo.BaseNameNoIdentifier()` → `p2`), while file-backed pages keep the existing behavior.
